relationship.translation_notes: Taxable profit and current tax are monetary amounts; rate is a base-one fraction.

assumptions: A single uniform rate applies to the full positive taxable profit for this period.
There are no tax credits, minimum taxes, prior-period adjustments or other tax components.
limitations: Current tax expense is not necessarily the ending tax payable: prepayments, refunds and prior balances must be considered.
Tax-loss carryforwards, tiered rates and jurisdiction-specific rules need additional treatment.
